The '''2015 Rosemount Jedi/Padawan Tournament''' was a two-person team event on 3 January 2015 at Legion Games in Burnsville, Minnesota. [[Mark Walseth]] organized it. Jedi and Padawan players swapped decks and played four games. Sean and Taylor won. Two glass trophies were engraved for the winners.<ref name="jedi15">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=56802 First Annual Jedi / Padawan Tournament-Burnsville, MN], forum.starwarsccg.org (12 December 2014 – 4 January 2015).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Legion Games, 3128 West Hwy 13, Burnsville, Minnesota<ref name="jedi15" />
* '''Date:''' 3 January 2015<ref name="jedi15" />
* '''Structure:''' random Jedi and Padawan pairs, a deck swap, then 4 games. The team score added both players' results<ref name="jedi15" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="jedi15" />
* '''Field:''' 24 paired players, 12 Jedi and 12 Padawan. Two more players arrived too late to play<ref name="jedi15" />
* '''Cost:''' $5 for a Jedi player, free for a Padawan<ref name="jedi15" />
